messages.subject: Strange Error
parts:
Hi, when I was trying to run following code I got strange error.


library(zoo)
dat <- zooreg(rnorm(13), start=as.yearmon("2009-01-01"), frequency=12)
dat1 <- data.frame(index(dat), coredata(dat))

ggplot(dat1) +
geom_line(aes(y = dat1[,2], x = dat1[,1]))

Error is :
Error in unit(at, "native") : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

The same code I has posted in my previous thread, however that time it
was working fine. I get this error while trying run the same in a
different system. Myy system configuration is :

sysname Windows
release Vista
version build 6002, Service Pack 2
machine x86

And R version is :

platform i386-pc-mingw32
arch i386
os mingw32
system i386, mingw32
status
major 2
minor 9.2
year 2009
month 08
day 24
svn rev 49384
language R
version.string R version 2.9.2 (2009-08-24)


Can anyone please help me why I am getting this error?

Thanks
